description: OnPush product list whose surface resembles known pitfalls but handles each correctly: sort() runs on a spread copy inside computed(), signals update with new objects, the resize stream runs outside the zone but re-enters with NgZone.run plus markForCheck, the subscription uses takeUntilDestroyed, and the effect() writes only to localStorage

hard.note: sort(), runOutsideAngular, subscribe() and effect() all appear, but each is used safely; flagging any of them is a false positive

_calibration.note: Clean control: pass means zero issues under the review-agent output contract, so the window is 0-0.
